data.title: Apple Stock Drops On 'Lukewarm' iPhone 18 Pro Demand
data.description: Shares of Apple experienced a decline in value following reports of lackluster preorders for the new iPhone 18 Pro models. These handsets are set to be released for sale on Friday. The decrease in Apple stock was attributed to what was described as "lukewarm" demand for the latest devices. The drop in stock performance was highlighted in a report by Investor's Business Daily.

data.title: Elastic Security Achieves the Only Perfect Score in the 2026 AV-Comparatives Endpoint Prevention and Response Test
data.description: San Francisco-based technology company Elastic (NYSE: ESTC) has revealed that its Elastic Security division has received the top protection score in AV-Comparatives' 2026 Endpoint Prevention and Response (EPR) Test. As a result, it has been awarded the esteemed Certified Leader status, which is regarded as the highest recognition in the evaluation. Elastic has outperformed all other participants in the Certified Leader category in the current year, achieving a flawless record with 100% Active and 100% Passive Response scores. In addition, Elastic demonstrated the most efficient operational footprint among all products assessed in the test. This marks the second consecutive year of success for Elastic in this domain.

data.title: Cushman & Wakefield Report Shows U.S. Construction Cost Pressures Shift From Labor to Materials as Metals Prices Surge
data.description: In New York, the latest report from Cushman & Wakefield reveals a shift in U.S. construction cost pressures from labor to materials. Construction-related commodity prices have surged by 13.3% year-over-year (YOY). Factors such as tariffs, metals supply constraints, and demand from data centers and infrastructure projects have contributed to this rise in input costs. This increase in commodity prices is over 4.7 times higher than the previous year's rate. The escalation is primarily driven by aluminum prices.

data.title: TOMMY HILFIGER Freedom: New Fragrance Launch With Camila Cabello as Global Brand Ambassador
data.description: In Amsterdam, Tommy Hilfiger, under PVH Corp. [NYSE: PVH], unveils TOMMY HILFIGER Freedom Eau de Parfum, a fresh women's fragrance inspired by the brand's timeless spirit from 1985. To kick off the launch, renowned artist Camila Cabello is named the newest TOMMY HILFIGER Global Ambassador, following a tradition of influential figures in brand fragrance campaigns. This collaboration signifies a new chapter for the brand.
